version_rationale: Round 6 requires an explicit semantic model revision for metadata-only exact attribution. Historical v1 inputs, labels and results remain unchanged and separately reported. V2 supplies the revision in two positive inputs and adds their original revision-free inputs as prudent-rejection negatives; it is a development compatibility check, not independent evaluation.
